role_summary: Senior director role at Mandarin Oriental's Hong Kong corporate office responsible for owning the IT governance framework across the global IT department and leading enterprise data governance in collaboration with the Data, Analytics & AI team. Reports to VP, IT Programs & Governance and chairs the Data Governance Council.
must_have_requirements: Minimum 8 years in IT governance, risk management, and compliance, including leadership roles
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
Strong knowledge of IT governance frameworks: COBIT, ITIL, DMBOK
Knowledge of information security standards: ISO 27001, NIST
Knowledge of data protection laws: GDPR and PIPL
Experience designing and implementing IT governance frameworks including policy development and stage-gate reviews
Experience establishing and maintaining IT risk management frameworks and risk registers
Experience managing regulatory compliance, audits, and audit findings
Ability to chair or lead governance councils and engage diverse cross-functional stakeholders
Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
nice_to_have_requirements: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or Business Administration
Professional certifications: CGEIT, COBIT 5/2019, ITIL, CRISC, CISSP, or DAMA CDMP
Experience in luxury hospitality, hotel, or multinational corporate environments
Experience collaborating with Data, Analytics, and AI teams on enterprise data governance
Familiarity with PIPL (China's Personal Information Protection Law) specifically
Experience leading a Center of Excellence (CoE) for data governance
Exposure to emerging technologies and proactive governance strategy development
soft_skills_priority: Leadership through influence (no direct line authority over all stakeholders implied)
Executive communication and stakeholder engagement across diverse functions and geographies
Strategic thinking with proactive anticipation of governance and technology trends
Integrity and accountability in enforcing policies and standards
Collaborative mindset for cross-functional council facilitation
Growth mindset and continuous improvement orientation
Organized and detail-oriented for audit management and policy documentation

scoring_criteria.name: IT Governance Framework Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility of the role is owning and enforcing the IT governance framework across the entire IT department; this is the primary deliverable.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Designed or implemented COBIT/ITIL-based governance frameworks
Developed IT policies, standards, and procedures
Led stage-gate review or quality assurance processes
Managed IT governance councils or steering committees
Years of experience in IT governance and compliance (target 8+)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from pure IT operations or project management without explicit governance ownership may score lower

scoring_criteria.name: Data Governance Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role co-leads enterprise data governance with the Data & AI team and chairs the Data Governance Council; data governance depth is a key differentiator.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Led or established a Data Governance Council or committee
Developed data policies, standards, and stewardship programs
Experience with DMBOK or DAMA frameworks
Led data standardization and data accountability initiatives
DAMA CDMP certification or equivalent
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Data governance experience is less common than IT governance; partial credit for adjacent data quality or MDM work

scoring_criteria.name: IT Risk Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Establishing and maintaining a comprehensive risk framework and risk register is a defined responsibility with ongoing operational impact.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Built or maintained an IT risk register
Conducted IT risk assessments and facilitated risk review meetings
Applied NIST or ISO 27001 risk frameworks
CRISC certification
Identified and implemented risk mitigation strategies

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory Compliance & Audit Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must ensure compliance with data privacy laws (GDPR, PIPL) and manage audit cycles; non-compliance creates significant legal and reputational risk for a global luxury brand.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Managed GDPR or PIPL compliance programs
Led internal or external IT audits
Remediated audit findings and reported to executive stakeholders
Cybersecurity regulatory compliance experience
Worked with legal or DPO teams on data privacy obligations

scoring_criteria.name: Relevant Certifications
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Certifications like CGEIT, COBIT, CRISC, CISSP, ITIL, or CDMP signal validated expertise and are listed as highly desirable in the JD.
evidence_type_to_look_for: CGEIT certification
COBIT 5 or 2019 certification
CRISC certification
CISSP certification
ITIL certification (v3 or v4)
DAMA CDMP certification
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Many qualified candidates will hold only one or two certifications; absence of all is a soft gap only

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Engagement & Council Facilitation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role chairs the Data Governance Council, facilitates the IT Governance Council, and must communicate decisions to diverse teams — influence without authority is critical.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Chaired or facilitated governance committees or councils
Prepared executive briefing materials or board packs
Engaged C-suite, business unit heads, or cross-regional stakeholders
Demonstrated leadership through influence rather than direct authority
Coordinated across IT, legal, compliance, and business functions

scoring_criteria.name: Knowledge of Information Security Standards
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: ISO 27001 and NIST are explicitly required; security standards underpin the compliance and risk responsibilities of the role.
evidence_type_to_look_for: ISO 27001 implementation or auditing experience
Applied NIST Cybersecurity Framework
CISSP or CISM certification
Information security policy development
Cybersecurity governance or compliance program management

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Planning & Continuous Improvement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role contributes to IT and data governance strategy and leads framework refinement initiatives; strategic mindset differentiates senior directors from managers.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Developed multi-year IT or data governance roadmaps
Led continuous improvement or best practice programs
Anticipated emerging technology or regulatory trends
Contributed to corporate IT strategy at senior level

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership Experience & Seniority
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Director-level role requiring demonstrated leadership; must have held leadership roles within the 8+ year experience window.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Director, Senior Manager, or equivalent title in IT governance
Team leadership or people management
Cross-functional program leadership
Reported to or partnered with VP or C-suite level

scoring_criteria.name: Industry or Global Corporate Context
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Hospitality or multinational corporate experience demonstrates familiarity with multi-property, cross-regional IT governance complexity.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Worked in hospitality, hotel, or luxury brand environment
Global or Asia-Pacific corporate IT experience
Governed IT across multiple properties or business units
